questions.q:
Match the following columns: | Column-I | Column-II |
|---|---|
| (A) $f(x) = \sin^2 2x - 2\sin^2 x$ | (P) Range contains no natural number |
| (B) $f(x) = \frac{4}{\pi} (\sin^{-1}(\sin \pi x))$ | (Q) Range contains atleast one integer |
| (C) $f(x) = \sqrt{\ln(\cos(\sin x))}$ | (R) Many one but not even function |
| (D) $f(x) = \tan^{-1} \left( \frac{x^2+1}{x^2+\sqrt{3}} \right) | ($S) Both many one and even function |
| | (T) Periodic but not odd function |

Match the following columns: | Column-I | Column-II |
|---|---|
| (A) If $|x^2-x| \ge x^2+x$, then complete set of values of $x$ is | (P) $(0, \infty)$ |
| (B) If $|x+y| > x-y$, where $x > 0$, then complete set of values of $y$ is | (Q) $(-\infty, 0]$ |
| (C) If $\log_2 x \ge \log_2 (x^2)$, then complete set of values of $x$ is | (R) $[-1, \infty)$ |

questions.q:
Match the following columns: | Column-I | Column-II |
| :--- | :--- |
| (A) Domain of $f(x) = \ln \tan^{-1} \{ (x^3 - 6x^2 + 11x - 6)x(e^x - 1) \}$ is | (P)  \left[-1, \frac{5}{4}\right]$ |
| (B) Range of $f(x) = \sin^2 \frac{x}{4} + \cos \frac{x}{4}$ is | (Q) $[2, \infty)$ |
| (C) The domain of function $f(x) = \sqrt{\log_{(|x| - 1)}(x^2 + 4x + 4)}$ is | (R) $(1, 2) \cup (3, \infty)$ |
| (D) Let $f(x) = \begin{cases} x^2 & x < 1 \\ x + 1 & x \ge 1 \end{cases}; g(x) = \begin{cases} x + 2 & x < 1 \\ x^2 & x \ge 1 \end{cases}$. Then range of function $f(g(x))$ is | (S) $[0, \infty)$ |
| | (T) $(-\infty, -3) \cup (-2, -1) \cup (2, \infty)$ |$

questions.q:
Let $f(x) = \begin{cases} 1 + x; & 0 \le x \le 2 \\ 3 - x; & 2 < x \le 3 \end{cases}$;
$g(x) = f(f(x))$ : | Column-I | Column-II |
| :--- | :--- |
| (A) If domain of $g(x)$ is $[a, b]$ then $b - a$ is | (P) $1$ |
| (B) If range of $g(x)$ is $[c, d]$ then $c + d$ is | (Q) $2$ |
| (C) $f(f(f(2))) + f(f(f(3)))$, is | (R) $3$ |
| (D) $m = \text{maximum value of } g(x) \text{ then } 2m - 2 \text{ is :}$ | (S) $4$ |

questions.q:
Given the graph of $y = f(x)$ below: Match the functions in Column-I with their correct graphs in Column-II:
Column-I (Function)Column-II (Graph)
(A) y = f(1-x) [Reflection about x = $\frac{1}{2} ]$(P) Graph shifted: passes through (-1,-2), (0,0), (1,1), (2,0)
(B) y = f(2x) [Horizontal compression by 2](Q) Original f(x) — peaks at (0,1)
(C) y = -2f(x) [Vertical flip and scale $\times$2 ](R) Graph compressed: peaks at (0,1) , x-range [-$\frac{1}{2},$1]
(D) y = 1 - f(x) [Vertical flip + shift up 1](S) Graph: passes through (-1,0) , minimum (0,-2) , passes through (1,0) , to (2,4)
